title: Loki: In childTextNodesAreLiteral, walking up the tree previously stopped at the nearest foreign ancestor once an HTML…
description: CVE-2026-97045 is a medium severity vulnerability affecting multiple versions of the Loki software. The issue occurs in the childTextNodesAreLiteral function, where tree traversal previously stopped incorrectly at the nearest foreign ancestor upon encountering an HTML integration point. This flaw has been addressed in fixed versions 3.5.12-r9, 1.8.0-r3, 1.9.0-r1, 1.11.1-r6, and 1.9.1-r7.
